[RTCT.11.1] A **cache seed** ([IARC.12]) is a setup-only
write of the engine-owned cache. It must be issued **before** `go_live`; after
the engine goes live the runtime must reject it with `DS_ERR_RT_LIVE`, as for any
state-shaping operation forbidden in the live phase. A seed performs no
allocation or blocking beyond the store write itself, so it does not bear on the
live-phase timing contract.
